why: This is the final decision of the flight. The filmstrip from the last move shows a gate growing and splitting to both edges before disappearing behind us - I'm crediting that as the left-gate transit. Forward view now shows a second gate (yellow posts, teal accents) at moderate range (~2m, judging by post size and gap vs earlier close-up encounters), sitting just slightly right of center, with room space visible beyond it - this is very likely the center gate. The policy proposes backing up and turning, which guarantees no progress since no further decisions remain; instead I'm committing to one clean forward run with a small rightward correction to center the opening and push through it now, our only remaining chance at the second gate.
